summary: Expedia CEO Ariane Gorin discusses the company’s third-quarter performance and forecast. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Gorin says travel demand remains resilient, particularly among affluent consumers, but the company is seeing some moderation ahead of the fourth quarter. (Source: Bloomberg)
